newsitem.title: EGYPT: Food firm profits up 58 pct in 95/96.
newsitem.headline: Food firm profits up 58 pct in 95/96.

text.p: Nasr Dehydrated Agricultural Products made net after-tax profits for financial 1995/96 of 3.099 million pounds, up 58.11 percent from 1.960 million a year earlier, according to audited results made available on Monday.
The Egyptian financial year ends on June 30.
Profits before tax rose to 4.727 million from 3.420 million in 1994/95.
But turnover declined to 22.547 million pounds from 25.670 million a year earlier.
Earlier this month, the state sold the private sector 59.4 percent, or 475,230 shares, of the company at 30.00 pounds a share. The shares closed on Sunday at 44.25 pounds.
